public_api.note: Release 0.4.0 is the stable promotion of the LOT-18/19/20 subledger and Financial Analysis line qualified in 0.4.0rc1. Receivable/payable due-item flows remain qualified through settlement allocation, open-item aging and exact normalized GL reconciliation; financial analysis remains read-only with EBE/EBITDA/CAF, FRNG/BFR/Net Treasury, ratios, deterministic trends and replayable AnalysisSnapshot evidence. Settlement concurrency guards, the Corporate Finance boundary and the stable 0.3.x imports/reporting baseline remain part of the release qualification. The package milestone is stable, while the public Python API remains intentionally unfrozen before 1.0 and LOT-21.
